import json, re, subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
end = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
start = end - timedelta(minutes=90)
out = subprocess.run(["aws", "logs", "filter-log-events", "--log-group-name", "/ecs/mott-booking-gateway", "--start-time", str(int(start.timestamp() * 1000)), "--end-time", str(int(end.timestamp() * 1000)), "--filter-pattern", "?raw_fetch ?raw_resolve ?date_source ?raw_refetch", "--query", "events[].message", "--output", "json"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
if out.returncode != 0:
    print("LOG_ERROR %s" % out.stderr.strip()[:200]); raise SystemExit(1)
events = json.loads(out.stdout or "[]")
print("LINES=%d (window %sZ..%sZ)" % (len(events), start.strftime("%H:%M"), end.strftime("%H:%M")))
mask = lambda s: re.sub(r"\d{5,}", lambda m: "***" + m.group(0)[-4:], str(s))
for e in events[-80:]:
    print("GW", mask(str(e).strip()[:220]))
print("DIAG_DONE")
